text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: C-City! I-I'm here t'wish you a<n>happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you remembered my birthday?<n>Thanks,
Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-you betcha! But, um... I don't<n>act'ally have your
present ready yet...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No biggie. Hearing you wish me a<n>happy birthday is
good enough<n>already.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y'see, I couldn't find anyth'n<n>glam'rous enough
that I thought<n>you'd like...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So I'm just gonna ask you instead.<n>Lemme know
what y'want, and I'll<n>go buy it, lickety-split!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Something I want, huh? I can really<n>ask for
anything?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-ask for anyth'n you want! Snacks,<n>makeup—you
name it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then, how about you give me a fun<n>day out
shopping with my friend?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And like, wouldn't going together be<n>way faster
than you worrying over<n>what to get all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
S-somebody pinch me! I get t'go<n>shopp'n with
City!
